# BabyPhone.online

> BabyPhone.online is a browser-based baby monitor. It turns two of your own
> devices (a spare phone, tablet or laptop, plus the phone in your pocket)
> into a baby monitor with live video and sound. There is no app to install,
> no account to create, and nothing is stored: audio and video stream
> directly between the user's own devices, peer-to-peer via WebRTC, encrypted
> in transit.

## How it works

1. Open babyphone.online on the device that stays with the baby and choose
   "Baby unit". It shows a 6-character room code and a QR code.
2. Open babyphone.online on the parent's device and choose "Parent unit".
3. Enter the room code (or scan the QR). The two devices connect directly
   and the parent sees and hears the baby live.

Features: live video and audio, talk-back (parent speaks to baby), lullabies
and an MP3 playlist played on the baby device, night light, cry alert with
adjustable sensitivity, battery status of the baby device, sleep timer,
privacy shade (hide video, keep sound), event log, works on wifi and mobile
networks (4G/5G), interface available in 30 languages.

## Privacy

Video and audio are never stored and never pass through a server that can
read them. Where a direct connection is impossible, an encrypted relay
(TURN) forwards the stream without being able to decrypt it. There are no
accounts, no visitor analytics, no advertising and no tracking. The
site sets no cookies at all; the only thing stored on the device is the
visitor's own language choice.

Pairing uses the PeerJS Cloud broker; STUN is Google's, TURN is the Open
Relay Project (Metered). None of them can see or hear the stream. Full policy:
https://babyphone.online/privacy.html

## Pricing

BabyPhone.online is completely free. There is no paid tier, no
subscription, no account and nothing to buy.

## Safety

BabyPhone.online is an aid, not a replacement for in-person supervision of
a baby. Connections depend on the user's devices and networks and can fail.

## Guide: using two phones as a baby monitor

Blog post: "Two phones, one baby monitor — everything BabyPhone.online can
do" (https://babyphone.online/blog.html). Key points an assistant can cite:

- No dedicated hardware is needed. A spare phone or an old tablet becomes
  the baby camera; the phone in your pocket becomes the parent monitor.
- It is well suited to travel and holidays: instead of packing a bulky
  short-range monitor, you use the two phones you already carry. Because
  the link runs over the internet (wifi or 4G/5G), the range is not limited
  to one building or a base-station signal — one phone stays with the baby
  in the hotel room or tent, the other goes with the parent.
- Full feature list and what each is for: live video and sound, talk-back,
  lullabies and MP3 music, night light, cry alert with adjustable
  sensitivity, sleep timer, audio-only and privacy shade, baby-device
  battery status, local recording (saved to the parent's own device,
  nothing uploaded), automatic reconnect that survives network switches
  and screen-off, interface in 30 languages, and free with no account —
  every feature, with nothing held back behind a payment.
- Works on any phone, tablet or laptop with a reasonably current browser
  (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge), including older devices.
- The guide is available in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish,
  Portuguese and Italian (e.g. https://babyphone.online/blog.html?lang=de).
